claim_text: Caffeine can interfere with sleep in a dose- and timing-dependent manner, but poor sleep or insomnia should not be attributed to caffeine alone and requires assessment of other causes when persistent.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, context-specific assessment and prevent inappropriate supplementation.

population.other_context: People reporting poor sleep or insomnia who consume caffeine.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and/or supplemental sources; verify product label and total exposure.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet describes caffeine use and adverse effects; sleep-specific guidance requires corroboration from sleep-medicine sources.
limitations: This claim does not establish a universal caffeine cut-off or diagnose the cause of insomnia.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
